title: Storey Architecture slide bars
description: A row of thin slideshow progress bars with gutter gaps: the current one is wider and fills with solid ink over the slide's duration, the others are faint tracks. Each bar is a button that jumps to its slide.
notes: inks with currentColor, so set the text colour of the parent (light on photos and dark bands)
controlled: the parent keeps the active index and the timer
under reduced motion the active bar is simply full
name: storeyarchitecture-slide-bars

props.name: duration
props.description: how long one slide stays, in ms (the fill takes this long)

props.name: onSelect
props.description: called with a slide's index when its bar is pressed

props.name: label
props.description: screen-reader label for each bar; the slide number is added after it
